methods.startup: goto start to DOMContentLoaded, real custom-element heldView/player/steps/picker readiness, visible Play and search controls, then two rAF. Always normal default; index state recorded before any control action. Repeated for both post-startup index controls, yielding 2*N default-startup samples per variant/mode.
methods.actions: Real fill/click, required visible matching result or selected journey/positive playback progress, then two rAF. Index state changed ONLY via #index-open or #attribute-index-toggle outside timed actions, reasserted after selection. Filtering cannot replace journey or reset/change playback mode/status.
methods.caches: Fresh isolated serial contexts; no warmup discarded; empty context HTTP cache/storage, no claim of cold OS filesystem or process/JIT caches. One shared serial browser. Routing is equal in both variants and disables browser HTTP cache.
methods.ordering: Alternate baseline/candidate starting order on sample parity plus loading-mode/index-control parity; no concurrent contexts or acceptance workers.
methods.comparison: No CDP session, tracing, init scripts or performance observers in compare mode. All observed latency values are retained; no instrumented profile duration enters comparisons.
methods.profiling: Separate run with CDP Performance counters, 1 ms CPU samples and streamed traces. Startup begin marker is injected at document creation, not navigation start; diagnostic startup excludes navigation before document creation. Other markers bound actual UI actions. Trace X events clipped to marker window on same renderer thread; inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed.
methods.bounds: At most 200 entries per console/request/CSP log; truncation is unresolved. At most 64 MiB per raw artifact and 512 MiB total, including partial traces; exceeding a cap fails collection rather than silently losing attribution. No heap snapshots or screenshots.
methods.variationRule: Unresolved when (max-min)/median > 0.25 AND range > corresponding absolute material threshold on either variant. Descriptive instability heuristic, not statistical significance. Add samples and inspect raw distribution.
